fields.claim:
As per our conversation, ECT is not to engage in business in the UK and, in 
this regard, is not to have business transacted by it or on its behalf 
anywhere except in the United States.  Accordingly, trades entered into by 
persons outside of the United States should not be confirmed as ECT trades.  
I hope all finds you well.  Best regards.

Read further into the Guam email chain. David Terlip forwarded Manuel Gallego's request to Janice Moore, noting ECT involvement and asking to hold off until she responds. This indicates a deliberate review process before approval, supporting the rival that approval was a considered business decision rather than a mistake.

I have no new substantive leads from the current batch of routine administrative emails. The truncated ECT Legal Conference message was already read; no further action needed there. I will continue to watch the Guam inquiry for any new evidence that might clarify the approval decision.

In response to your email, yes, our confidentiality language was so limited 
that it did not allow us to provide the agreement to affiliates of either 
party without consent.  We revised the form about 9 months ago to broaden the 
langage to include affiliates, but Duke is an old master so they need our 
consent so they can provide it to their affiliate.  Unless Federico has any 
reason not to waive the language, I think we can go ahead & draft a waiver up 
here and send it to Duke.  Can you talk to Federico asap and run that by him 
and let me know so I can get this over to Duke.  Thanks!

that it did not allow us to provide the agreement to affiliates of either 
party without consent.  We revised the form about 9 months ago to broaden the 
langage to include affiliates, but Duke is an old master so they need our

reason not to waive the language, I think we can go ahead & draft a waiver up 
here and send it to Duke.  Can you talk to Federico asap and run that by him 
and let me know so I can get this over to Duke.  Thanks!

the fifth line thereof.  Additionally, the last sentence needs to be deleted, 
because the indemnity agreement needs to remain in effect for so long as EFI 
is
